Your house in 3D – room sizes

A simple walk-through built from the Sensopia floor plan for George Street, South Hiendley, including the cellar. Furniture is made up and the stairs are simplified, so treat it as a guide rather than exact measurements.

You start on the pavement outside. Walk in through the front door with WASD and look around with the mouse.

On a phone: use the joystick (bottom left) to walk and drag anywhere else to look around. Turn your phone sideways for the best view.
